design: Top-decile lift of the peer-trained ranking f_h^(-c) of the forward test on campus c's own outcomes anchored in 2016 or earlier, per building system, over all pre-2017 quarters and over the eight quarters 2015 Q1 to 2016 Q4, with a building bootstrap interval; the resulting direct local verdicts are compared with the peer and local-history verdicts of the forward test against the lift realized in 2017 to 2019.

definitions.scores: f_h^(-c): trained on the other campuses' rows anchored in 2016 or earlier (deployed configuration severity_labour|p75|M1|gbdt), scoring campus c; stored predictions of the forward test, not refitted
definitions.labels: high-burden unit: reactive labour in quarter t+1 above the system-specific 75th percentile of positive next-quarter reactive labour, fitted on the training rows of f_h^(-c) (the other campuses' rows anchored in 2016 or earlier); no outcome of campus c enters it

windows.all: every anchor quarter of campus c in 2016 or earlier
windows.last8: the eight anchor quarters 2015 Q1 to 2016 Q4

definitions.label_dating: a row anchored in 2016 Q4 carries the label of 2017 Q1; the 2017 to 2019 outcome starts with the label of 2017 Q2
definitions.evaluable: >= 10 high-burden units and >= 100 units in the window
definitions.lift: top-decile lift within (campus, building system, window)
definitions.interval: 95% percentile interval, buildings resampled with replacement, 1000 resamples, seed 42; resamples without a high-burden unit are dropped (n_boot records the rest)
definitions.validated_margin: evaluable, lift >= 2 and lower end of the interval >= 2
definitions.not_validated: evaluable and the validation condition not met
definitions.holds: top-decile lift in 2017 to 2019 of at least 2 (pairs evaluable then)
definitions.peer_supported: evidence score from peers' pre-2017 records S_peer >= 0.67
definitions.local_history_supported: evidence score from local history S_local >= 0.67; no verdict when the stratum has < 20 high-burden units or < 200 units before 2017
definitions.rank_correlation: Spearman, over the pairs where the predictor exists; 95% interval from 2000 resamples of pairs, seed 42
definitions.wilson_95: Wilson score interval for the share that holds

statements.note: distinguishable means the 95% bootstrap interval of rho(direct local lift) - rho(peer evidence score), computed on the pairs where both exist at that window, excludes zero; None for the shortest W means that the difference is distinguishable with the full pre-2017 record only
